subject: Television & Streaming
title: Quinta Brunson and Network TV's Survival
description: One-minute skill: Quinta Brunson and Network TV's Survival.

hook.text: Abbott Elementary premiered on ABC in 2022 and became the biggest network comedy hit in years. Critics were stunned.

buildup.text: Quinta Brunson created a show about underfunded public schools. She drew from her mother's career as a teacher.

discovery.text: The mockumentary format felt fresh again because Brunson used it to tell warm, working-class stories rarely seen on TV.

twist.text: In an era dominated by streaming, a broadcast network comedy became a cultural phenomenon. Nobody predicted that.

climax.text: Brunson proved that network TV isn't dead—it needed creators who spoke to audiences that streaming platforms overlooked.

punchline.text: A show about teachers reminded TV how to reach people.
